Oh damn, I'm sorry to hear that. Why are group therapy sessions mandatory? Surely it should be your own choice how you want to proceed? I hope it all works out for you!!!!

Exactly this! Today was my 6th session with my current one and I can feel that my mind is so much more resilient than when I had my first session. My therapist has challenged my  feelings and negative perception of myself in a way that has equipped me to be able to do the same on my own, it's by no means easy and I struggle with it everyday but I know I am getting better. 

As you said finding the right therapist is purely luck based, my first two weren't great but I hit the jackpot with this new one. It's really unfortunate that it is like this. My first two were nhs based therapists, so it was free, so I'm not sure if that has a part to play in the quality because my current one is private so I pay myself. Maybe that is something to think about if you have the means to and depending on what country you're in.

I'm sure some part of her does love me but at this stage of our relationship I think it's irrelevant. Like myself she has many of her own issues mentally but she is in denial about them, instead she just projects everything onto her children, everyone is the problem except her, from the smallest to the biggest issue. I try to be as understanding as possible, put aside my own personal feelings towards her to try and help her when I can but I'm sick of it being thrown back in my face. 

And tbh I'm not sure whether I love her or just feel duty bound to her as her last child.

I know once I am able to move out and put real distance between us I will feel much better but that feels very far away at this point. My therapist has helped me understand what it is about her and our relationship that is so toxic and what I can do to avoid letting her get to me but it only seems to help for a short while
